# PDF QR Code Scanner

> Client-side web app that scans QR codes from PDF files and exports results as CSV. No backend, no build step, no telemetry.

- `index.html` — single-page UI: file input, scan button, progress bar. Uses Bootstrap 5 for styling.
- `src/app.js` — UI orchestrator: file selection, calling scanPDF, progress updates, CSV download.
- `src/scan.js` — deep PDF scanning module. Exports `scanPDF(pdfDoc, options?) → Promise<ScanResult[]>`. Renders PDF pages as offscreen canvases via pdfjs-dist and feeds them to a worker pool.
- `src/decode.js` — QR decoding seam. Wraps zxing-wasm's `readBarcodes` (QR-only, self-hosted wasm), orders codes and dedupes exact duplicates per page.
- `src/scss/custom.css` — compiled Bootstrap 5 CSS.
- Libraries: pdfjs-dist (v4.x, PDF rendering), zxing-wasm (v3.x, multi-QR decoding). Served from `node_modules/`; the wasm is self-hosted (no CDN).

Single-page, zero-build, ESM module graph. `src/app.js` is the entry point — it imports `scanPDF` from `src/scan.js`; `scan.js` and the module worker import the decoder from `src/decode.js`. pdfjs-dist is resolved via an `<script type="importmap">`. No framework, no bundler.

Scan pipeline:
1. User selects PDF → `pdfjsLib.getDocument()` parses it in a web worker.
2. `scanPDF` iterates pages, renders each to an offscreen canvas, and decodes it through the worker pool.
3. Every code on the page is returned as `{ page, data, position }`, sorted top-to-bottom / left-to-right with exact per-page duplicates removed.
4. Caller formats as CSV and triggers browser download.

## Docs

- [index.html](index.html): Single-page UI — file input, scan button, progress bar
- [src/app.js](src/app.js): UI orchestrator — file selection, scanning, progress updates, CSV download
- [src/scan.js](src/scan.js): Deep PDF scanning module with pdfjs-dist rendering and a worker pool
- [src/decode.js](src/decode.js): QR-only zxing-wasm decoder, reading-order sort and per-page dedup
